welcome: Welcome to Lakeside. We built this place for slow mornings on the jetty and long nights round the fire pit. Grab a kayak, put your feet up and treat it like home.

rules.title: Quiet hours
rules.body: Please keep noise down from 10pm to 7am. Sound carries across the lake, and our neighbours will thank you.

rules.title: Fire pit
rules.body: Only light the fire pit in the pit itself, and never leave it alone. Put it out fully with water before you go to bed or leave the property.

rules.title: Jetty and kayaks
rules.body: Wear a life jacket on the water and keep children close by on the jetty. Do not swim or kayak after dark.

rules.title: No smoking
rules.body: Please do not smoke inside the house. Use the outdoor areas and put butts in a bin, not on the ground or in the lake.

rules.title: Guests and parties
rules.body: The home sleeps 6. Please do not host extra overnight guests or parties.

rules.title: Rubbish and recycling
rules.body: Put rubbish and recycling in the right bins outside. Keep food scraps out of the lake.

howto.title: Wi-Fi and door code
howto.body: Look at the TV home screen for the Wi-Fi name, password and door code. Scan the QR code to open the same details on your phone.

howto.title: Air conditioning
howto.body: Use the air conditioning controls on the TV, or on the phone page from the QR code. Please switch it off when you head out.

howto.title: Fire pit
howto.body: Use the dry wood stacked nearby and a small pile of kindling. Keep the fire small and keep a bucket of water close. Soak it before you leave it.

howto.title: Kayaks
howto.body: Kayaks and life jackets are by the jetty. Pull the kayaks back up out of the water when you finish.

howto.title: Bins and recycling
howto.body: Bins are outside the house. Take the rubbish out on your last morning.

items.name: Raes Dining Room
items.note: Mediterranean-style dinner on Wategos Beach. Book it for a special night.

items.name: Beach Byron Bay
items.note: Relaxed meals with ocean views right on Clarkes Beach.

items.name: Pixie Food & Wine
items.note: Italian on Jonson Street. Good for a cosy dinner for two.

items.name: Fishheads
items.note: Casual seafood for an easy lunch or dinner.

items.name: Cape Byron Lighthouse walk
items.note: A 3.7 km loop with lookouts on the way up. Go early before it gets busy.

items.name: Stone & Wood Brewery
items.note: Try the beers on tap with a burger or pizza. A tasting paddle is on offer.

items.name: Cape Byron Maritime Museum
items.note: Small museum at the base of the lighthouse. Easy to add to the walk.

items.name: Byron Community Market
items.note: Live music, local food and handmade goods. It runs on the first Sunday of the month.

items.name: Bayleaf Cafe
items.note: Relaxed spot on Marvell Street with a mostly healthy menu. Try the coconut cold brew.

items.name: Sparrow Coffee
items.note: Allpress coffee on Byron Street, close to the main strip.

items.name: Espressohead
items.note: A local favourite in town for around 15 years.

items.name: Wategos Beach
items.note: A sheltered beach below the lighthouse. Lovely for a swim and a picnic.

items.name: Clarkes Beach
items.note: Easy beach right by the town centre. Walk along the sand to the lighthouse track.

items.name: Byron Bay Farmers Market
items.note: Bread, fruit, juices and vegetables from local growers. Check the current day and time before you go.

steps: Strip the beds and leave the used linen in a pile
Put the dishes in the dishwasher and run it
Take the rubbish and recycling to the outside bins
Make sure the fire pit is out and soaked with water
Bring the kayaks and life jackets in from the jetty
Turn off the air conditioning and lights, then lock up

emergency.name: Byron Central Hospital, 54 Ewingsdale Road, Ewingsdale
